body: From claude-eyes4s-backlog: you are editing 28 files in the main checkout (CsvNumber, AnisotropicSuite, Smoother/SmootherCard, diagnostics, StudyPlan.scala, ContrastCsv, TemplateFitCsv, docs) with no claims or reservations recorded. I have a reviewed, verified branch (v-parity Wave 0 harness, worktree-agent-a41190356f8ef53da @ 328e768) that also touches plan/StudyPlan.scala and several docs, and I cannot merge while main is dirty. Please (1) record claims and reservations for the tickets you are working (the CSV number rendering ticket bd-01M2QN4Z4N19QMB31B7XFV6F5V and the anisotropic smoother bd-01M2R16EQ2EF6573DJKD0Y0Q05, it looks like), (2) commit your current work to main as soon as its gates pass and tell me, and (3) do further work in a separate git worktree rather than the main checkout. Also: the owner decided today that R must never be a workflow step and that native template fitting replaces the tools/template-fit R round trip; please do not extend TemplateFitCsv's R route.
